label: build F2 4/4
result:
F2 unit 4 is finished: `server/checks/f2.py` covers §2.12 F2's acceptance and runs clean, and I walked every page at 1280 and 390, light and dark, with a new and a seeded learner. Five small defects turned up in my files and are fixed and committed; two items need other owners.

The branch doesn't have F5 and F6 yet, so on the branch alone the check skips the parts that need F5. I also ran it on a scratch copy of master with the F2 files laid over it (F5 and F6 included). There every part runs, 18 pages pass with no console errors, and `test_flow.py` prints "all good". On the branch alone, `test_flow.py` also prints "all good".

**Earlier work kept:** a predecessor left the check and an automated walk already committed (up to 41228cc). I continued from there and redid nothing.

**Fixed:**
- **Check failed on master:** `/admin/reports/` (F6's staff page) loads no shell, so the walk wrongly failed there. It now counts `/admin/` pages as bare, like the session runner and the test window.
- **Palette count was wrong:** the Suggested "Today's set" row said 10 questions (the set-length setting) while Today's own Start runs 28 on a 45-minute plan. It now uses the plan's count, falling back to the setting.
- **Storage banner never showed:** it only appeared when both localStorage and sessionStorage were blocked. With sessionStorage alone the code lasts one tab, so closing it loses the progress. It now shows whenever localStorage is blocked.
- **False 0-day streak on the phone:** the phone bar showed "0" when there was no shell data (offline with nothing cached, or a signed-out code). It stays hidden until the data arrives.
- **Blank user card:** with no data, the sidebar's user card had an empty name. It now reads "Account".
- **New checks:** the signed-out banner and the blocked-storage banner, at 1280 and 390.

Also checked by eye and working: the account menu, the palette on desktop and phone, the quick sheet, the shortcuts sheet, the rail and its peek, the 900px layout, the phone menu sheet, the offline banner, the save nudge, and the achievement and report toasts (fed fake shell data, since no achievements exist yet).

**Needed from other owners:**
- **F1 (`web/assets/ui.css`):** on screens under 1100px tall, the sidebar user card leaves 71px for the name, so the default "Student 92D9" (88px) shows as "Student …". Hiding the chevron `.side-user > svg` at that height would free enough room.
- **`server/next.py` (Up next):** the upgrades assign it to F2, but this task doesn't own it and it isn't built. `/api/shell` returns `next: []`, so the Up next cell in the Now strip, the sidebar's Up next block, the rail's play button and `G N` have nothing to show. `api_shell.py` already reads it once it exists. `web/sw.js`, also given to F2 by the upgrades, is not built either.

The F1 view-transition follow-up in `head.js` was already done in an earlier unit.

**Commits this session** (on v2/f2, not pushed, HEAD detached at 9811bca, tree clean, servers stopped):
- 7e9fc74 checks/f2: staff pages under /admin/ carry no shell, so the walk passes on master with F5 and F6
- 30ebee9 palette.js: Today's set starts the plan's count, as Today's own Start does
- 9811bca ui.js: the storage banner when localStorage refuses; no 0-day streak or blank user card without data
